mapper.select: SELECT m.*, sender.name AS sender_name, sender.avatar_url AS sender_avatar_url, receiver.name AS receiver_name, receiver.avatar_url AS receiver_avatar_url, t.title AS task_title FROM messages m LEFT JOIN users sender ON m.sender_id = sender.id LEFT JOIN users receiver ON m.receiver_id = receiver.id LEFT JOIN tasks t ON m.task_id = t.id WHERE m.id = #{id}

SELECT m.*, sender.name AS sender_name, sender.avatar_url AS sender_avatar_url, receiver.name AS receiver_name, receiver.avatar_url AS receiver_avatar_url, t.title AS task_title FROM messages m LEFT JOIN users sender ON m.sender_id = sender.id LEFT JOIN users receiver ON m.receiver_id = receiver.id LEFT JOIN tasks t ON m.task_id = t.id WHERE m.sender_id = #{userId} OR m.receiver_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC
